input: Cancel unused gym membership this week

gold.taskTitle: Cancel Unused Gym Membership This Week
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to cancel their gym membership by the end of this week.

questions.title: Which gym or fitness chain are you cancelling?
questions.description: Identify the specific gym so the correct cancellation process can be followed.

questions.title: How are you currently billed for the membership?
questions.description: Determine if billing is via direct debit, credit card, or another method to know what needs to be stopped.

questions.title: Do you know if cancellation requires in-person visit?
questions.description: Some gyms only allow cancellation in person, which affects how the task is approached.

questions.title: Is there a minimum notice period before cancellation takes effect?
questions.description: Understand if there is a contractual notice period that could delay or complicate the cancellation.

questions.title: Are you still within a minimum contract term?
questions.description: Determine if there is a remaining contract that could result in an early cancellation fee.

questions.title: Do you have your membership account details or ID number?
questions.description: Check if the user has the necessary credentials ready to complete the cancellation.

questions.title: What is your specific deadline day within this week?
questions.description: Pin down the exact day by which the cancellation must be completed to set the right urgency.
